James Stephenson (@ICannot_Enough)

The headline literally said: Sell $TSLA.
Check the date. 8 years ago this month.
Why? “The competition is coming.” 👀





— https://nitter.net/ICannot_Enough/status/2041674702377078899#m

SpaceXAI Colossus 2 now has 7 models in training:

- Imagine V2
- 2 variants of 1T
- 2 variants of 1.5T
- 6T
- 10T

Some catching up to do.

Funny pricing indeed


Marc Andreessen 🇺🇸 (@pmarca)

The pricing tiers for AGI are something like (1) $20/month, (2) $200/day = ~$75,000/year, (3) $1,000/day = ~$350,000/year, and (4) ~$10 billion. For now.



— https://nitter.net/pmarca/status/2041662281092886546#m

One day, we will be out there, among the stars


NASA (@NASA)

Sky full of stars.

Following a successful lunar flyby, the Artemis II astronauts captured this breathtaking photo of our galaxy, the Milky Way, on April 7, 2026.





— https://nitter.net/NASA/status/2041707173428748594#m
